## Summary
- Tested on game patch **0.35.15** (Steam buildid **24420237**).
- Rebuild required: older RU packs crash (`Bad export index` on `W_WelcomeScreen` / mic indicator).
- ST + UI + fonts (replaces `StormEscape-Windows.pak`, backup `.bak_ru`)
